title: Sicherheitskooperation (SiKoop) der Länder führt gemeinsame Aktionswoche gegen Straftaten zum Nachteil von älteren Menschen (SÄM) durch

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin and four other German states launch a joint action week (29 June to 5 July 2026) on crime against older people, mainly fraud such as phone scams and fake shops. Berlin police are running more than 40 prevention events citywide.
